architectReview.evidence: G005 is implemented as a backend-owned saved-place and share-intake core: authenticated share intake creation, deterministic candidate extraction, one-candidate confirmation, multi-candidate selection, zero-candidate draft/manual-fix flow, synchronized ResolveShareIntake orchestration, saved place CRUD, REELS_PLACE folder isolation, and FolderCapabilityPolicy-protected writes.

executorQa.evidence: The focused saved-place/share-intake API suite and the full Spring Boot verification suite pass. Tests cover candidate extraction status transitions, single-candidate confirmation, multi-candidate forced selection, zero-candidate draft plus manual fix, atomic single-use resolution, saved place list/filter/detail/update/delete, folder-type isolation, and viewer read/write behavior.

artifactRefs.description: Share intake, candidate resolution, saved place CRUD, folder-type, and role-matrix API report.
OpenAPI parity report including share-intake and saved-place endpoints.
Checked-in OpenAPI contract refreshed with G005 endpoints.

contractCoverage.obligation: Authenticated clients can create share intake items from raw URL/title/text payloads and preserve the original payload plus normalized URL.
Candidate extraction distinguishes one candidate, multiple candidates, and no candidate states for confirm/select/manual-fix flows.
ResolveShareIntake creates the saved place and marks the intake resolved once, rejecting replayed resolution attempts.
Folder members can browse/detail saved places, and authorized writers can update/delete saved places with category/status/keyword/region filtering.
Saved places and share intake resolution are confined to REELS_PLACE folders and cannot leak into PHOTO_DIARY folders.
The backend-owned OpenAPI contract exposes bearer-secured share-intake and saved-place operations without contract drift.

adversarialCases.scenario: A share intake is created against a PHOTO_DIARY folder.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: The request is rejected with INVALID_ARGUMENT.

adversarialCases.scenario: A share payload extracts two candidates and resolve is called without candidateId or manualName.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: The intake remains unresolved and the request is rejected with INVALID_ARGUMENT.

adversarialCases.scenario: A URL-only share payload yields no candidate.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: The intake enters NEEDS_MANUAL_FIX, can be saved as DRAFT, and can later resolve from manual place fields.

adversarialCases.scenario: A resolved intake is resolved a second time.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: The replay is rejected with CONFLICT.

adversarialCases.scenario: A viewer reads saved places but tries to resolve an intake or patch a saved place.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Reads succeed and writes are denied with FOLDER_WRITE_NOT_ALLOWED.

adversarialCases.scenario: Runtime OpenAPI is compared with the checked-in contract after adding place endpoints.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: The checked-in contract matches runtime docs and includes bearer-protected share-intake and saved-place operations.

iteration.evidence: After implementing the saved-place and share-intake core, the focused place API suite and the full OpenAPI refresh plus Spring Boot test suite were rerun cleanly against the current repository state.
